description: This Java abstract class, ContactAccessor, provides an SDK-independent API for communication with the Contacts Provider on Android devices. It contains methods to retrieve a contact picker intent and to load contact data, with implementation details varying based on SDK version.

classes.name: ContactAccessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing SDK-independent methods to access contact information on Android, with dynamic implementation based on API level.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ContactAccessor, dynamically instantiating the appropriate SDK-specific subclass based on device API level.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Abstract method that returns an Intent configured to pick a contact, implementation varies by SDK version.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Abstract method to load contact data into a ContactInfo object from a specified URI, implementation varies by SDK version.
